title: Robert Aramayo’s Star-Making Turn in ‘I Swear’ Is Already Award-Winning, Now He Just Wants People to See It
summary: The "I Swear" star nabbed two BAFTAs at this year's fraught ceremony, but as he tells IndieWire, the next step isn't more glory — it's just more audience members, more knowledge, and hopefully more understanding.

title: ‘The Lowdown’ Season 2 Finale Hinges on Two Monologues — Let Ethan Hawke and Sterlin Harjo Break Them Down
summary: The creator explains how he wrote a monologue worthy of Tommy Lee Jones (that doubles as an "homage" to his speech in "No Country For Old Men"), while the star wants to nominate Peter Dinklage's ferocious eulogy for an Oscar: "It was like, 'Let me show you kids how to do a poem!'"
